name: Zen Republic Cache Control
author: infozenrepublices

sections.description:
Zen Republic Cache Control provides an intuitive interface for managing your site’s cache on the Zen Republic High Performance WordPress platform.

Features

  • Real-time Cache Status – See instantly whether pages are served from cache or origin server
  • One-click Purge – Clear cache for the current page or entire site from the admin bar
  • Auto-purge on Changes – Cache automatically clears when you update posts, pages, comments, menus, or themes
  • WooCommerce Support – Automatically purges product pages when stock levels change
  • Platform Detection – Clear messaging when the platform is not detected

Cache Status Indicators

  • Lightning Fast! (Green) – Page served from cache
  • Loading from Server (Yellow) – Page fetched fresh from origin
  • Admin Bypass (Gray) – Admin pages never cached for security
  • Platform Not Detected (Red) – Not running on Zen Republic platform
sections.installation:
1. Upload the zen-republic-cache-control folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress
  3. The cache control menu will appear in your admin bar
sections.faq:
Why do I see Platform Not Detected?

This plugin is designed for the Zen Republic High Performance WordPress platform. If you see this message, your site is not running on the platform.

Why does the admin dashboard show Admin Bypass?

Admin pages are intentionally excluded from caching for security reasons. Each admin request is served fresh from the server.

How do I purge the cache?

Click on the ZRp Cache menu in the admin bar. You can purge the current page or the entire site.
